---
title: "QRemote example"
subtitle: "Control this deck from your iPhone or Apple Watch"
format:
  revealjs:
    revealjs-plugins: [qremote]
    embed-resources: true
qremote:
  # Slides without a `timing` attribute count up. Set e.g. 30 to give them 30 s.
  default-timing: null
---

## Timed slide {timing="20"}

This slide has 20 seconds. The watch buzzes lightly 5 seconds before the end, then twice at 0:00.

::: {.notes}
Notes appear on the iPhone remote and in the speaker view (S key).
:::

## Two steps {timing="1:00"}

The first tap on **Next** shows the next fragment…

::: {.fragment}
…then the next tap goes to the next slide.
:::

## Untimed slide

No `timing` here: the remotes show the time spent on this slide instead of a countdown.

## Thank you {timing="15"}

Press **P** to pause the countdown, **R** to reset the clocks.
